scope_note: Dedicated last-resort model-eligibility pass for State Farm Olathe under study-modeling-policy-1.3.0. Four bounded syntheses are retained: the exact 2025 parcel-tax-payment identity as a same-account public-service-cost break-even threshold, plus low-confidence descriptive 2024 Johnson County GDP, employment and wage comparison gaps using the repository's pre-2016 inverse-distance benchmark. No estimate is an observed cost, net fiscal result or causal facility effect. Supplier/local-spend and community-allocation candidates, an HPIP credit counterfactual, and causal county designs are rejected because the project-specific inputs, scope matches, non-overlap proof or identification conditions recorded in the evidence fragment are absent.

estimates.label: Annual local public-service-cost break-even threshold

scope.label: Parcel R662349 / DP69210000 0001 property-tax account spanning its local taxing recipients

interval.interpretation: The threshold equals the verified 2025 parcel-tax payment by definition; it is not an estimate of actual public-service cost.

parameters.name: same_scope_parcel_tax_contribution

provenance.detail: Verified tax-year 2025 payment for parcel account R662349

parameters.transformation: Defines the equal-cost break-even threshold without reallocating the payment among recipients

estimates.confidence_rationale: The threshold identity is exact for the cited parcel payment, while actual recipient-specific marginal public costs and the distribution of the payment are unavailable.
estimates.decision_relevance: States the same-account annual public-cost level that would offset the verified recurring parcel-tax contribution without manufacturing a cost or net position.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Project-attributable police, fire, road, utility, administrative, infrastructure and financing costs for the same parcel-tax recipients and tax year

derivation.formula: annual marginal local public-service cost at break-even = verified tax-year 2025 parcel property-tax payment
assumptions: The threshold is an exact arithmetic identity, not an observed public cost.
No HPIP credit, other incentive, sales or income tax, interest, penalty or unrelated government revenue is netted into the parcel account.
The parcel payment is left unallocated because the public account does not provide recipient-level marginal costs.

limitations: No positive or negative fiscal margin is asserted.
The parcel payment spans several recipients whose shares and marginal costs may differ.
The threshold covers one tax year and one real-property account, not all operator taxes or public obligations.
estimates.notes: Standalone break-even identity only; it must not be summed with the source tax claim or presented as actual cost or net fiscal benefit.

estimates.label: Modeled county real GDP comparison gap

period.label: 2024 Johnson County outcome relative to a mechanically matched benchmark; facility built and leased in 2016

scope.label: State Farm Olathe facility and Johnson County descriptive comparison

interval.interpretation: Central is the 2024 percentage gap; width is twice the 2008-2015 pre-period RMSE. It is a fit sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.

parameters.name: built_year_anchor

provenance.detail: Filed property description reports construction in 2016 and State Farm use by the filing date

parameters.transformation: Defines 2008-2015 as the fit period; it is not treated as first county exposure

provenance.detail: Johnson County 2024 real GDP from the county economic panel

parameters.name: comparison_2024_value

provenance.detail: Inverse-distance weighted 2024 real GDP from 20 non-study comparison counties

parameters.transformation: Subtracted from host and used as denominator

parameters.name: pre_period_rmse_percent
parameters.transformation: Twice RMSE sets the fit-sensitivity width

estimates.confidence_rationale: The benchmark is reproducible, but the opening anchor is not first county exposure and the donor pool is not a validated unexposed causal control group.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows Johnson County's 2024 real-GDP divergence from a transparent benchmark without assigning the divergence to State Farm.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: A defensible causal design with complete county data-center exposure history, treatment isolation, validated controls, placebos, spillover rules and robustness diagnostics

derivation.formula: 100 × (Johnson County 2024 real GDP − inverse-distance-weighted 20-county benchmark) ÷ benchmark
assumptions: Matching uses 2008-2015 log level, average log growth and growth volatility, with feature scales 1.0, 0.03 and 0.03.
The 20 nearest eligible counties are weighted by 1 ÷ (square root of feature distance + 0.05); all study counties are excluded.
The 2016 built/lease anchor is not assumed to be first Johnson County data-center exposure or an isolated treatment date.

limitations: This comparison is descriptive and must not be interpreted as a data-center effect.
Johnson County had other data-center activity and concurrent investments.
The donor screen cannot exclude every unobserved treatment.
The interval is fit sensitivity, not statistical confidence.
estimates.notes: Low-confidence descriptive county benchmark gap only; no causal-design metadata or attribution is attached.
